english: Can you show me this skirt please?

chinese: 尽量试着用好你的时间。
pinyin: jǐn liàng shì zhe yòng hǎo nǐ de shí jiān.
english: Try to make the most of your time.

pinyin: nǐ de bǐ bǐ wǒ de hǎo.
english: Your pen is better than mine.

pinyin: wǒ bù tài kàn bào zhǐ.
english: I don't read newspapers much.

chinese: 他是一名很好的老师，对吗？
pinyin: tā shì yī míng hěn hǎo de lǎo shī, duì ma?
english: He's a very good teacher, isn't he?

chinese: 我回来了！啊？有人来看我们吗？
pinyin: wǒ huí lai le! ǎ? yǒu rén lái kàn wǒ men ma?
english: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

pinyin: wǒ hěn hǎo, nǐ ne?
english: I'm fine, and you?

chinese: 你不是个好人。这你知道，对吗？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì ge hǎo rén. zhè nǐ zhī dào, duì ma?
english: You are not a good person. You know that, right?

pinyin: hǎo! nǐ huì hòu huǐ de.
english: All right! You will be sorry for this.

chinese: 万一你生病了，吃这个药。
pinyin: wàn yī nǐ shēng bìng le, chī zhè ge yào.
english: Take this medicine in case you get sick.

pinyin: tā kàn le yī yǎn tā de biǎo.
english: He glanced at his watch.

pinyin: yī qiè dōu hǎo.
english: All good.

chinese: 你有一个固定的男朋友吗？
pinyin: nǐ yǒu yī gè gù dìng de nán péng you ma?
english: Do you have a steady boyfriend?

chinese: 他一直抱怨他的房间很小。
pinyin: tā yī zhí bào yuàn tā de fáng jiān hěn xiǎo.
english: He is always complaining of his room being small.

chinese: 天哪，你看起来真不一样！
pinyin: tiān na, nǐ kàn qǐ lai zhēn bù yī yàng!
english: Oh my God, you look so different!

chinese: 你上次小便是什么时候？
pinyin: nǐ shàng cì xiǎo biàn shì shén me shí hou?
english: When was the last time you urinated?

pinyin: nǐ zài hū xī ma?
english: Are you breathing?

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng tīng nǐ de lǐ lùn.
english: I don't want to hear your theories.

pinyin: nǐ què dìng méi yǒu zhè me zuò ba?
english: Tell me you didn't do this.

pinyin: wǒ men bǎo chí le chén mò.
english: We kept quiet.

pinyin: zhè liàng zì xíng chē shǔ yú wǒ.
english: This bicycle belongs to me.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiǎn féi.
english: I want to lose weight.

pinyin: dà jiā zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma?
english: Is everyone ready?

pinyin: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo.
english: It's fine today.

chinese: 这本书是不是他一直用的？
pinyin: zhè běn shū shì bù shì tā yī zhí yòng de?
english: Is this book the one he always uses?

pinyin: zhǔn bèi hǎo jì xù le ma?
english: Are you ready to proceed?

chinese: 上个月你看了几部电影？
pinyin: shàng gè yuè nǐ kàn le jǐ bù diàn yǐng?
english: How many movies did you watch last month?

pinyin: duō hǎo de zhǔ yi ā!
english: What a good idea!

pinyin: wǒ jǐn liàng liú zhe wèi chī tián diǎn.
english: I try to save room for dessert.

pinyin: ràng wǒ kàn kan nǐ yǒu duō shao qián.
english: Show me how much money you have.

chinese: 我希望他很快就能好起来。
pinyin: wǒ xī wàng tā hěn kuài jiù néng hǎo qǐ lai.
english: I hope he will get well soon.

chinese: 你真的在考慮你这把年纪还重婚吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhēn de zài kǎo lǜ nǐ zhè bǎ nián jì hái chóng hūn ma?
english: Are you seriously thinking about getting married again at your age?

chinese: 我可以借你的灰色西装吗？
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de huī sè xī zhuāng ma?
english: Could I borrow your gray suit?

pinyin: wǒ běn bù yīng gāi zuò de.
english: I shouldn't've done it.

chinese: 几天前我在站看到了他。
pinyin: jǐ tiān qián wǒ zài zhàn kàn dào le tā.
english: I saw him at the station a few days ago.

chinese: 他是我太太认识的一个人。
pinyin: tā shì wǒ tài tai rèn shi de yī gè rén.
english: He is acquainted with my wife.

pinyin: tā chū xí le huì yì.
english: He was present at the meeting.

pinyin: wǒ zěn me kàn bu jiàn tā men?
english: Why can't I see them?

pinyin: wǒ kàn shū de shí hou shuì zháo le.
english: I fell asleep while reading.

pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ huì chàng gē jiù hǎo le.
english: If you can sing, that's good enough.

chinese: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。
pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ cháo xiào tā de fāng shì.
english: I don't like the way you laugh at her.

pinyin: nà sōu chuán shàng yǒu duō shao rén?
english: How many people were aboard that ship?

pinyin: nà zuò tǎ yǒu duō gāo ā?
english: How high is that tower?

chinese: 求你了，给我一个瓶子吧！
pinyin: qiú nǐ le, gěi wǒ yī gè píng zi ba!
english: I beg you, give me a bottle!

pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ qiān zhe nǐ de shǒu ma?
english: Can I hold your hand?

chinese: 除非雨停了，我们才会出去。
pinyin: chú fēi yǔ tíng le, wǒ men cái huì chū qù.
english: We won't go out unless it stops raining.

chinese: 你在那么暗的地方做什么？
pinyin: nǐ zài nà me àn de dì fang zuò shén me?
english: What are you doing in a dark place like that?

pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ de yīng xióng.
english: You're my hero.

pinyin: nǐ tōu le duō shao qián?
english: How much money did you steal?

pinyin: tā yǒu hěn duō lì shǐ shū jí.
english: He has a lot of books on history.

pinyin: zhè ge ràng wǒ jīng yà dào le!
english: It caught me by surprise.

chinese: 你对他的回答不感到惊讶吗？
pinyin: nǐ duì tā de huí dá bù gǎn dào jīng yà ma?
english: Doesn't his answer surprise you?

chinese: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
pinyin: yǒu kòng de shí hou, wǒ zǒng xǐ huan tīng gǔ diǎn yīn yuè.
english: I always enjoy listening to classical music in my free time.

chinese: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
pinyin: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì.
english: What he says is total nonsense.

pinyin: kàn nà zuò bèi xuě fù gài de shān.
english: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.

chinese: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？
pinyin: nǐ jiàn dào jīn tiān zǎo shang de cǎi hóng le ma?
english: Did you see the rainbow this morning?

pinyin: wǒ bèi tā de gù shi gǎn rǎn le.
english: I was very impressed by his story.

pinyin: tā kàn bu qǐ wǒ.
english: She despises me.

pinyin: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shén me ān pái lā?
english: What do you have planned tomorrow?

pinyin: zhè fù yǎn jìng r bù shì wǒ de.
english: These glasses aren't mine.

chinese: 你对古典音乐会有什么可说的吗？
pinyin: nǐ duì gǔ diǎn yīn yuè huì yǒu shén me kě shuō de ma?
english: Do you have any information on classical music concerts?

chinese: 我们很快就会知道真相了。
pinyin: wǒ men hěn kuài jiù huì zhī dào zhēn xiàng le.
english: We'll know the real story soon enough.

chinese: 我觉得这就是我们所需要的。
pinyin: wǒ jué de zhè jiù shì wǒ men suǒ xū yào de.
english: I thought that that's what we needed.

chinese: 我弟弟手里拿着一个摄像机。
pinyin: wǒ dì di shǒu lǐ ná zhe yī gè shè xiàng jī.
english: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.

chinese: 我爸爸退休了，以便为更年轻的人让路。
pinyin: wǒ bà ba tuì xiū le, yǐ biàn wèi gèng nián qīng de rén ràng lù.
english: My father retired to make way for younger people.

pinyin: gé bì jiā de gǒu hěn shì wēi xiǎn.
english: The dog next door is dangerous.

pinyin: nǐ néng gěi wǒ tǔ dòu ní ma?
english: Could you pass me the mashed potato?

pinyin: wǒ bù huì shàng dàng de.
english: I won't be fooled.

pinyin: nǐ bù néng qī piàn wǒ.
english: You cannot pull the wool over my eyes.

chinese: 世界上最美丽的地方在哪里？
pinyin: shì jiè shàng zuì měi lì de dì fang zài nǎ lǐ?
english: Where is the most beautiful place in the world?

pinyin: zhè huí shì lún dào wǒ jīng yà le.
english: Now it was my turn to be surprised.

pinyin: nà nán rén tōu le wǒ de qián bāo.
english: That man stole my wallet.

chinese: 你在用的那支筆是我的。
pinyin: nǐ zài yòng de nà zhī bǐ shì wǒ de.
english: That pencil you're writing with is mine.

chinese: 有了，在中国人民的心中。
pinyin: yǒu le, zài zhōng guó rén mín de xīn zhōng.
english: It has: it is in the heart of the Chinese people.

pinyin: nǐ men zài àn shì shén me?
english: What are you driving at?

chinese: 我没发现任何我该道歉的理由。
pinyin: wǒ méi fā xiàn rèn hé wǒ gāi dào qiàn de lǐ yóu.
english: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.

pinyin: ràng wǒ men jiǎ shè tā zài zhè li.
english: Let us suppose she is here.

chinese: 这是我第一次犯这样的错误。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì fàn zhè yàng de cuò wù.
english: This is the first time I've ever made a mistake like this.

pinyin: wǒ bù rèn wéi tā hěn zài yì.
english: I don't think she cares very much.

pinyin: tā sǐ zài tā de huái lǐ.
english: She died in his arms.

pinyin: wài miàn dǎ léi le, wǒ hěn hài pà!
english: It's thundering outside. I'm really scared!

chinese: 他比镇里的其他人都有钱。
pinyin: tā bǐ zhèn lǐ de qí tā rén dōu yǒu qián.
english: He is richer than anyone else in this town.

pinyin: tā chéng gōng de táo tuō le.
english: He managed to escape.

pinyin: sǐ shì wéi yī de jiě tuō ma?
english: Is death the only release?

pinyin: zhè kē zuàn shí bù shì zhēn de.
english: This diamond isn't real.

chinese: 你昨天上午有打网球吗？
pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān shàng wǔ yǒu dǎ wǎng qiú ma?
english: Did you play tennis yesterday morning?

pinyin: wǒ kàn jiàn tā bèi jǐng chá dài bǔ.
english: I saw him caught by the police.

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng chuī niú.
english: I don't mean to brag.

chinese: 我现在在上班，所以晚点打给你。
pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài zài shàng bān, suǒ yǐ wǎn diǎn dǎ gěi nǐ.
english: I'm at work now, so I'll call you later.

pinyin: kē xué hé shù xué wǒ dōu xǐ huan.
english: I like both science and math.

chinese: 如果你想活得久一点就戒烟。
pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng huó de jiǔ yī diǎn jiù jiè yān.
english: Quit smoking if you don't want to die early.

pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me dǎ wǒ?
english: Why did you hit me?

pinyin: nǐ jué de tā zài shuō huǎng ma?
english: Do you think her story is false?

chinese: 你很快就会习惯吃日本料理了。
pinyin: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn chī rì běn liào lǐ le.
english: You'll soon get used to Japanese food.

pinyin: nà xiē rén shì zuì fàn ma?
english: Are they criminals?

pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ tiào wǔ ma?
english: Will you dance with me?

pinyin: liǎng gè zhēn tàn gēn zhe xián yí rén.
english: Two detectives followed the suspect.

chinese: 那不是一颗真正的钻石，对吗？
pinyin: nà bù shì yī kē zhēn zhèng de zuàn shí, duì ma?
english: That's not a real diamond, is it?

chinese: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？
pinyin: wǒ néng gēn nǐ sī xià tán yī fēn zhōng ma?
english: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?

chinese: 你想用什么语言和我交谈？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng yòng shén me yǔ yán hé wǒ jiāo tán?
english: What language do you want to talk in with me?

chinese: 你进这幢楼的时候是几点？
pinyin: nǐ jìn zhè zhuàng lóu de shí hou shì jǐ diǎn?
english: What time was it when you entered the building?

chinese: 你希望我们和你一起去吗？
pinyin: nǐ xī wàng wǒ men hé nǐ yī qǐ qù ma?
english: Do you want us to go with you?

pinyin: nǐ hé wǒ yǒu xiāng tóng de xiǎng fǎ.
english: You and I have the same idea.

pinyin: zhè shì shéi de fén mù?
english: Whose tomb is this?

pinyin: nǐ fēng le ma?
english: Are you mad?

chinese: 那我就不继续打扰你，玩数独游戏去了。
pinyin: nà wǒ jiù bù jì xù dǎ rǎo nǐ, wán shù dú yóu xì qù le.
english: I will play Sudoku then instead of continuing to bother you.

chinese: 他一到伦敦就给我发了电报。
pinyin: tā yī dào lún dūn jiù gěi wǒ fā le diàn bào.
english: On his arrival in London, he sent me a telegram.

pinyin: nǐ zài jiān yù lǐ dāi le duō jiǔ?
english: How long were you in jail?

pinyin: wǒ néng hé lǎo shī shuō huà ma?
english: Can I speak with the teacher?

pinyin: wǒ zhǐ gào su nǐ, tā yǒu diǎn chǔn.
english: Between you and me, he is rather stupid.

chinese: 他私下给我看了她的照片。
pinyin: tā sī xià gěi wǒ kàn le tā de zhào piàn.
english: He showed me her picture in private.

pinyin: tā wǎng qiú dǎ de hěn làn.
english: He is rather poor at tennis.

pinyin: wǒ dǎ le tā de dù zi.
english: I hit him in the belly.

pinyin: nǐ yòu hé tāng mǔ chǎo jià le ma?
english: Did you have another fight with Tom?

pinyin: wǒ de xiōng dì shì gè bèn dàn.
english: My brother is an idiot.

pinyin: wǒ shuō nǐ yīng dé de.
english: I'd say you earned it.

chinese: 你說不定知道他的名字？
pinyin: nǐ shuō bu dìng zhī dào tā de míng zi?
english: Do you happen to know his name?

chinese: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！
pinyin: bù yào zài jiǎ zhuāng yī qiè dōu hǎo le, bù shì zhè yàng de!
english: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.

chinese: 他们的计划我一无所知。
pinyin: tā men de jì huà wǒ yī wú suǒ zhī.
english: I am quite ignorant of their plan.

pinyin: zhōu yī gào su wǒ nǐ de jué dìng.
english: Let me know what you've decided on Monday.

pinyin: jiǎ zhuāng nǐ shì wǒ.
english: Pretend you're me.

chinese: 这对他来说是致命的打击。
pinyin: zhè duì tā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de dǎ jī.
english: To him this is a deadly blow.

chinese: 有一个叫米勒的想见你。
pinyin: yǒu yī gè jiào mǐ lè de xiǎng jiàn nǐ.
english: A Mr. Miller wants to see you.

chinese: 我不需要接種流感疫苗。
pinyin: wǒ bù xū yào jiē zhòng liú gǎn yì miáo.
english: I don't need a flu shot.

pinyin: zhè shì tā men yīng dé de.
english: They deserve it.

chinese: 在这个城市，很难打到的。
pinyin: zài zhè ge chéng shì, hěn nán dǎ dào dí.
english: In this city, it's hard to get one.

pinyin: wǒ cóng qián hé nǐ yī yàng qióng.
english: I used to be poor like you.

chinese: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。
pinyin: wǒ lǎo bǎn bǎ jiān jù de rèn wu zhǐ pài gěi le wǒ.
english: My boss assigned the hard job to me.

chinese: 我可以和你跳一支舞嗎？
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ hé nǐ tiào yī zhī wǔ ma?
english: Can I have a dance with you?

pinyin: bù yào niǔ qū wǒ shuō de huà.
english: Don't twist my words.

pinyin: nǐ yǒu hé tā shuō guo huà ma?
english: Do you ever talk to her?

chinese: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。
pinyin: wǒ bì xū wèn nǐ yī gè chǔn wèn tí.
english: I need to ask you a silly question.

pinyin: yī kuài yán shí cóng shàng miàn luò xià.
english: A rock fell from above.

pinyin: wǒ xū yào yī xiē hǎo de zhōng gào.
english: I need some good advice.

pinyin: wǒ bù shì guǐ.
english: I'm not a ghost.

chinese: 想吃一点巧克力奶酪吗？
pinyin: xiǎng chī yī diǎn qiǎo kè lì nǎi lào ma?
english: How about some chocolate cheese?

chinese: 我们很高兴接受你的提议。
pinyin: wǒ men hěn gāo xìng jiē shòu nǐ de tí yì.
english: We gladly accept your offer.

chinese: 这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。
pinyin: zhè shì tā de yú chǔn fù chū dài jià le.
english: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.

pinyin: tā zài jiáo kǒu xiāng táng, shì ma?
english: She's chewing gum, isn't she?

pinyin: zāo le! wǒ zhòng le tā de jì!
english: Crap! I fell for his trap!

pinyin: wǒ yòu bǎ tā men hùn xiáo le!
english: I mixed them up again!
